# National Association of Home Builders (NAHB)

> > The National Association of Home Builders (NAHB) is the leading trade association representing home builders, remodelers, and residential construction professionals, advocating for housing policy, affordability, workforce development, and industry safety standards.

NAHB serves as the primary voice for the residential construction industry, working with Congress on housing legislation like the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, providing safety programs for builders and contractors, and addressing critical issues including building codes, housing supply, affordability challenges, and regulatory reform. The organization hosts the International Builders' Show (IBS) and maintains close relationships with research institutions like Harvard's Joint Center for Housing Studies (JCHS).

## Key Topics

- Housing affordability crisis
- 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act
- Workforce development and CTE programs
- Building codes and IECC amendments
- Housing legislation and advocacy
- NAHB Safety & Health Programs
- International Builders' Show (IBS)
- Housing supply and demand
- Regulatory reform and executive orders
- Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC)
- Mortgage rates and household mobility
- Tariffs and construction costs
- Multifamily housing development
- Local HBA initiatives and campaigns
- BuildPAC and political advocacy

## Housing Policy and Legislative Advocacy

- [Senate Panel Advances NAHB-Supported Housing Package](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/07/road-to-housing-senate-package): Senate Banking Committee unanimously approves ROAD to Housing Act package
- [Latest Executive Orders Promise Regulatory Reform and Relief](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/04/eos-promise-regulatory-reform-relief): Trump executive orders target regulatory relief and Chevron doctrine
- [NY HBA Requests Federal Action on State Gas Ban](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/07/nysba-gas-ban-efforts): NAHB and NYSBA request AG Bondi act on NY fossil fuel appliance ban
- [Bipartisan Companion LIHTC Bill Introduced in Senate](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/04/bipartisan-lihtc-bill-introduced-in-senate): Sens. Young and Cantwell introduce bill to expand LIHTC affordable housing
- [NAHB Cites Policy Priorities to Bipartisan Working Group](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2026/02/bipartisan-working-group): Lake Coulson presents housing legislation and workforce priorities to Congress
- [Senate Panel Passes NAHB-Backed Forestry Bill](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/10/senate-fix-our-forests-act): Senate Agriculture Committee advances Fix Our Forests Act for lumber supply

## Housing Market Analysis and Economic Research

- [Harvard Report Shows the Housing Affordability Crisis Worsening](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/06/harvard-report-shows-the-housing-affordability-crisis-worsening): Harvard JCHS report reveals record housing unaffordability and low sales
- [Cost and Tariff Uncertainty Weighs on Markets](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/03/eoe-summary-cost-tariff-uncertainty): Chief Economist Robert Dietz analyzes tariff impact on construction costs
- [New Study Reveals Projections of a Slowdown in Household Growth, Housing Demand](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2025/01/jchc-study-on-household-formations-2025-2045): Harvard JCHS projects slower household growth impacting housing demand 2025-2045
- [Home Owners Feel Stuck, Opt to Remodel Rather than Relocate](https://www.nahb.org/blog/2026/02/home-owners-feel-stuck): Low household mobility drives remodeling growth amid mortgage lock-in
